column4: cleat#2043: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect, and mysql and mssql skip in this PostgreSQL-only job while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name, not by delta: env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./engine/ -run TestASecretOnlyFieldRefusesALiteralAndEventHistoryNeverHoldsIt -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these two, and 0 failures. Proves a secret-only field's literal never reaches event_history on any dialect -- postgres running here still exercises the mechanism, the other two dialects just aren't reachable in this job.

same dialect gating as the cluster job's line in test-a-secret-only-field-refuses-a-literal-and-event-history-never-holds-it.tsv, but a SEPARATE job key: `Test Go (engine) on 1.26` also runs `go test -p 1 ./engine/...` against PostgreSQL only (CLEAT_TEST_DB, ci.yml's test-go matrix entry "engine"), so it independently owes these same two dialect skips. The ledger is keyed per job, so one line does not cover both invocations. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./engine/ -run TestASecretOnlyFieldRefusesALiteralAndEventHistoryNeverHoldsIt -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these two.
